'''P-3B2''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that worked in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
